architecture_contract.selection_warning: The released trainer early-stops and selects on training AUROC rather than validation AUROC. Benchmark use must prespecify a donor-safe validation criterion and cannot copy this choice uncritically.

embedding_contract.warning: scBasset cannot produce an embedding for a new held cell without changing the output layer and retraining. Training-cell embeddings must never be presented as inductive held-donor predictions.

implementation.checkpoint_policy: Train from scratch only for an explicitly registered, development-only, transductive ATAC task. Public tutorial weights are provenance records and are not transferable MASLD initializations.

inference_contract.common_profile_lane: predict accessibility of each sequence in each outer-training cell, average those predictions within the frozen training-only cell-state labels, and repeat the resulting cell-state profile across held donors
inference_contract.donor_context: none; every held donor receives the same training-cell-state mean prediction and the output is labeled sequence_only
inference_contract.native_transductive_lane: 32d embeddings and denoised accessibility for cells represented as output columns during local fitting only
inference_contract.profile_fixture: The adapter must emit the frozen donor-by-cell-state peak matrix from sequence alone and reject any held-donor ATAC matrix or target columns.

input_contract.accessibility_target: binary_peak_accessibility; the generator uses sparse nonzero indices and discards count magnitude
input_contract.canonical_sequence: 1344-bp GRCh38.p14 one-hot sequence centered on each training-defined peak
input_contract.peak_filtering: upstream README recommends retaining peaks accessible in at least five percent of cells; every threshold and peak call must be fit on outer-training donors only
input_contract.reference: GRCh38.p14 project FASTA and GENCODE v49 contract
input_contract.split: held genomic blocks with a 1344-bp boundary buffer; the released random peak split is not benchmark-admissible
input_contract.warning: Released preprocessing maps every N base to an unseeded random nucleotide. Benchmark admission requires rejecting ambiguous sequence windows or replacing this with a prespecified deterministic encoding validated against the original model. Peak rows from ArchR getPeakSet may not match matrix order; the source explicitly warns to use matrix rowRanges.

source_evidence: The full pinned repository commit, Apache-2.0 license, official Nature Methods paper/README, and immutable Google Cloud Storage response metadata were queried on 2026-08-22. No package was installed, no checkpoint body was downloaded, and no model was run.

task_fit.development_only_candidate: transductive ATAC representation, denoising, and sequence attribution after a separate TaskSpec and donor-safe interpretation are frozen
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: conditionally eligible as the registered sequence-only baseline by training-cell-state aggregation; it cannot model donor-specific RNA context and remains constant across held donors
task_fit.sealed_cell_state_mapping: ineligible because the sealed GSE289173 row universe is RNA-only and scBasset is ATAC-specific
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: limited to sequence-to-training-cell accessibility diagnostics; not a standalone signed eQTL/ieQTL or enhancer-gene model
